beats.line: this puts you in a deadly situation where you honestly believe
you're swimming towards the exit when in reality you're swimming deeper into the system
and if you somehow manage to stay focused you will eventually reach the silt-out
this is a narrow confined area where you must be extra
careful not to disturb the silt-covered floors
one wrong kick of your flippers will instantly stir the silt
causing the water to become extremely murky
and reducing your visibility to absolute zero
this is the exact moment that has killed many divers causing
them to lose the guidelines and eventually run out of air
